title: Whole-Head Cocktail Party fNIRS
description: Whole-head functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) recordings from 38 participants performing covert and overt spatial-attention tasks in a cocktail-party paradigm, with simultaneous eye tracking. The montage comprises 56 sources and 144 detectors, yielding 1134 measurement channels sampled at about 8.99 Hz. Tasks include overt and covert attention, a visual orienting baseline, resting state, and video-locked attention recordings.
methods_description: fNIRS was recorded with 56 sources and 144 detectors (1134 channels, ~8.99 Hz) alongside eye tracking. Participants performed overt audiovisual spatial attention, covert auditory attention with central fixation, eye-movement-only orienting, and 5-minute resting fixation tasks. Events were aligned either to the orienting cue or to video onset for GLM analysis.
